tei:div.tei:p: "$ (1na1)las kyi gshin rje'i sbyor ba'i dug nag po ha la ha la zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

(1ba2)mthu stobs mchog gi ya lad ji snyed pa/ rgyal ba kun las rnyed de lnga brgya par// bdud dgrar 'ongs te bdud 'dul las kun la// dpa' zhing rtul phod bsgrub der phyag bgyi'o// e ma sdig par rngams rnams la// mi 'dod pa yi gnod pa'i sde// gcig tu spungs 'dra cig car gyi// gshin rje dmar po'i gnam lcags 'bab// khro bor bsnyen dang gdong brnyan du// bsgrub cing ging du rbad pa shis// dur khrod gnas sam lhor blta'i brag /zangs ri 'dra ba'i 'gram du ste// lho phyogs dur khrod g.yul bskrad dang*// lha srin drag gnas sa dag gis// bsad pa'i 'brub dong gru gsum brtsigs// dur khrod ro sol zhal bar bya// rang byung zhal phya rab gnas pa// mi yi rgyu mas bsgril te bzhag /gtor ling rgyun du zas su sbyin// steng du me rlung 'khrug pa'i nang*// thod pa khrag mtshos bskor ba'i dbus// zangs mkhar gru gsum sgo gcig pa// gzhi ljang 'khor lo mthing nag ni// rtsibs bzhi thod pa'i mu khyud bri// rgyal rigs thod tshal sngags rigs kyi// dum bzhir gtso bo yab yum sku// ba con lnga la btags te gzugs// ra glang mi rta khrag sbrus pa'i// zla gam gsum steng zur gsum bshos// rtse mo ru mtshon 'phyar pa lnga// khyi spyang sprel thod gang rung nang*// ming gzugs bla rdo bla shing la// tri dza du me bris pa la/ dam sri ru tri trig nan bskor// bden bdar nas ni btab pa'i bar// tī rā dza du me// rgyal 'gong dam sri mā ra ya rbad/ rā dza trig nan rā dza hur thuṃ/ pa tsa 'dri ma thi/ ba ra rā dza tsa sbur srog nan/ snying gzer dred shag yaṃ rbad/ 'don cing de la thun gyis brab// tsa tri du me srog la breng breng*// tsa la dun dun sbur nan// khaṃ shag rbad/ tsit+ta ro myags rbad/ srog la thun rbad bh+yo/ dug phyung khram shig rbad/ tsa tri mam dbugs la thang gzir rbad// khri thon pa'am rtags mthong nas// spyang dug sbyad tsher gu gul bdug

/rgya gram la maṃ them 'og mnan/ bdag nyid lhar bltas rten sbyangs nas/ hūṃ bsgom sngags kyi sgra bsgrags (2na3)pas// lho phyogs gshin rje'i rgyal po bskyed// tsā muṇ+ḍi ni grib ma bzhin// gtso bo'i gnas bzhi las spros pa'i// dza las rtsibs bzhir blon po ste// pra ma ra tsa zom zha ma// ya ma ra tsa ga yang gzhi ma// da sha gri ba dan sha ma// yak+ṣa kā la phor thogs ma// bsam gyis mi khyab ging gis bskor// gsal bar bskyed pa de dag la// 'byung ba rten bzhi'i rngam 'og dang*// lho phyogs dur khrod tsa ri tra// mā la ya sogs gnas rnams nas// las kyi gshin rje 'khor bcas 'bod// bzhugs gsol bstim nas phyag byas te// dam bsgrag byin bskyed mchod cing bstod// 'od kyi sbro bsdu la dmigs te// gsang sngags 'di ni ma yengs bzlas// oṃ shrī man+dzupya ma rā dza ma ma e ka dza ti dza dzaḥde nas 'khor gyi sngags 'di gdags// pra ma ra tsa dza dza/ ya ma ra tsa dza dza/ da sha gṛ ba dza dza/ yak+ṣa kā la dza dza/ oṃ su tri ba ya/ pa ra tsi ta/ yo tri shwa ra// ya ma tsit+ta hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ de nas las sngags 'di la'o// oṃ āḥya ma ra dzā sa do me ya// ya me do ru nga yo da ya/ ya da yo ni ra ya k+ṣe/ yak+ṣe ya ts+tsha ni rā ma ya hūṃ phaṭa/ dngos nyams rmi lam dag tu ni/ gshin rje'i rgyal po mdun du 'ongs// mi khrag chang gi yon chab phul// sha chen gtor ma chen po byin// be con phyag rgya bstan nas kyang*// bdag gi las 'di sgrubs shig bsgo// phyin chad gtor ma byin tsam gyis// de yis byed 'gyur gdon mi za// dngos grub blangs la tshogs mchod dang*// bskang ba dag gis mnyes par bya// mthar ni rten la bzhugs su gsol// mi sbrul bya khra phag rog gi// snying dang khrag sbrus gtor ma ste// mi khrag a r+ghaṃ gsum yar 'bul// gsur chen dud pa rgyun mi bcad// ngan sngags bzlas pa'i thun rdzas bshams// 'byung ba gshed 'bebs 'khor lo ni// rang byung zhal gyi steng 'og bar// rgyu rkyen drug gi dmigs rten la// gshed 'bebs 'khor lo gnas bzhir bskor// byad ma de yi gnas bzhi ru// nyon mongs rdzas su grub pa las// las kyi gshin rje bzhi ru bzhengs// (2

ba 4)bskyed nas mchod cing bstod byas la// bskul bas klad pa ro myags bzhu// gsang lam dbang po tshal par byas// srog la me sbar smyo zhing brgyal// lte ba'i srid pa'i rten bcas bsam// rang gnad sngags kyi gnya' mnan te// gsal bar byas na ngan sngags bzlas// rang gnad sngags ni 'di yin te// tsi ta sbur nan// s+t+wa bha ya nan/ myags thibs ro myags nan// u nan/ e nan/ ri ri gzir/ trig nan/ big nan/ dun dun tsi ta dun snying khrag rbad// shag ti khas/ snying la thibs 'dred// u u/ ri ri/ ha ra ha ra dza ya/ hur thums dza/ sa ma ya hri ti gar ba khug drongs/ dun dzā hri/ thums ril snying la rbad/ ro myogs u sha ga rbad/ sha tsi khrag rbad/ khaṃ shag rbad/ ma du ha la dza la raṃ rbad/ thums myags trig shag mā ra ya rbad e a ya ma du ru tsa sha na ma/ klad tsa kun bcad myos/ myogs mun khas thibs/ hub ling dun ru dra khrag /klad khrag myogs mā ra ya rbad/ shag tri oṃ de bhi hriṃ he dun khrag /ma brin khrag myogs mā ra ya rbad/ tsaṇ+ḍa ta khrag ha ha ya du hu sti khrag /snying khrag myogs mā ra ya rbad/ ra ga hu sa ti mon tā khrag /lta khrag myogs mā ra ya rbad/ de yi ngan sngags 'di yin te/ u ne u ne u ne/ oṃ kad na ma ya/ dza ra ma ra ya/ tsi ta ka ye/ ta pa la tsan+d+ra badz+ra mā ra ya phye/ dza ti ma ma dza la phaṭa/ sarba pa pa dza ma ti hūṃ hūṃ/ ha ma he gaṃ/ tsa gran tra tsa la phaṭa/ kri la sha ka ra rbad/ kri tsa ya k+ṣa rbad su dza hūṃ phaṭa/ rni mā ra/ ma ra dza dza tshal pa tshal pu rbad su nan sho ma shak+ti shag shag phaṭa dza dza/ myogs mun khas thim/ hub ling dun du tra khrag /klad khrag myogs mā ra ya rbad/ shag tri oṃ de bhi hriṃ he dun khrag /mgrin khrag myogs mā ra ya rbad/ tsaṇ+ḍa ra khrag ha ha ya du hu sti khrag /snying khrag mā ra ya myogs rbad ya/ ra ga hu sti mon ta ha ba khrag /lte khrag myogs mā ra ya rbad ya/ brgya brgya'i mtshams su thun gyis brab/

de nas nya 'u'i ltag pa na/ 'chi bdag gdong brnyan can bzhengs par/ mchod bstod bskul bas gshed du babs/ (3na5)rang srog rang gis gcod bcu ba nas/ bla tshe srog dbugs zos par bsam/ babs ro langs rāk+ṣa snying la babs/ ya ma ra tsa'i snying rtsa rom baṃ ril rbad/ ya ma ra tsa snying la khug thum ril rbad/ ya ma ra tsa khrag la thibs rbad/ ya ma ra tsa mugs thibs drad/ ya ma ra tsa subs ril rbad/ ya ma ra tsa gling du ya rbad rbad/ sngar bzhin brgya brgyar thun brab bo// zhag ni nyi shu gcig tu bya/ dug gi chu la liṅga sbangs// rtsad gi phur pas gnas bdun gdab// liṅga thod bcas klu la gtad// staṃ ba ya nan/ u nan+ta u/ an+ta a/ ri rab 'og tu tshud bzhin 'gro/ thun dang gtor ma dgra la brdeg /dam tshig nyams na rang srog gcod// ma nyams dus las mi 'da'o// dkyus bzhin ma byung lan gsum bskyar// las kyi gshin rje'i rtog pa'i rgyud// 'bum phrag mang po'i snying tig yin// bya rog g.yas dang 'ug pa'i g.yon// dang rur dgra lha a ṇi bris// bar du phra men gzugs kyis dkrug /sgro gnyis rtsa ba tshon skud bcing*// shing btags rlung la 'thab du gzhug /thun gyis brab cing sngags 'dis bskul// ma mā trag rak+ṣa mā ra ya phye/ ma ma trag rak+ṣa ru dra mā ra ya phye/ trag kha hid mā ra ya dzaḥtrag kha hi da mā ra ya khug /a ni trag rak+ṣa mā ra ya phye/ de nas rme dud rnam lnga la/ oṃ laṃ ku sa ma du hu lu lid myos myos na rgal/ ga gzer ga na ya/ sngags 'dis 'dug par bya ba yin/ oṃ ya ma rā dza klu ling bha sang sang*/ ku na bha sang sang*/ klu ling sang ku ta nan/ yo lcags sang ku ta kaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ 'bum bzlas dug gi chu la btab/ de nas sgro yis blangs nas kyang*/ na mo rata na trā ya yā/ tsa la tsa la/ pra tsā la pra tsā la/ shrī ga da ga mi ni swāhā/ ta ku ta ku/ pa ra ba ra ma ta ni dza ni mā ra ya/ ma ra du/ ya ma snying*/ ya ma khrag /tshal pa baṃ ril da pa dum bu hūṃ phaṭa/

ni sha ku ru ni sha ku ru kha so ba tri yaṃ/ sen men yang*/ snying tshal pa rbad/ dun dun mug pa (3 ba 6)shad/ ha la ha la/ tsa la tsa la/ pa tsa pa tsa/ hi li hi li/ rba na rba na/ rbad pu li da rbad pu lid/ me sha ya me sha ya/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ sta na sta na/ rban rban/ rbad na rbud rbad na rbud/ snying shos ya/ 'ur 'ur rab tu 'ur/ chem chem rab tu chem/ ya ma yaṃ las la yaṃ/ sri li sri li li/ ya ya/ rgyob rgyob/ ces bzlas ling ga de la gdab/ de yi lha lta 'bros par 'gyur/ de nas bden bdar bla dgug ste/ a mu kaṃ/ e ā rak+ṣa ya dza/ yaṃ dza a tsa tsa a tsa tsha hriṃ dza/ gang yin gnas nas 'gugs par byed// rtags thon drag po'i dus la me'i/ sbyor ba brtsams par bya ba ste/ dur khrod sa la dug chus sbrus// me thab mtho gang brtsigs pa'i nang*// dbus su rdo rje rgya gram dang*// logs la me ri bri bar bya// bsgrub dus ling ga gnyis byas pa'i// gcig ni nang du gan rgyal lo// gcig ni phye mar brdungs byas la// ming byang re dang sbags la ni// bag phye dug chus sbyar ba'i zan// ril bur byas pa'i nang du gzhug /tshil chen du ni de btso'o// mar nag chang dang mi rta yi// sha dang rus pa khrag gu gul// sreg rdzas thod pa'i nang du'o// tsher can se dri can dug shing*// sreg pa'i yam shing bya ba yin// me thab zangs mkhar chen por bsam// dbus su las gshin yab yum bsgom// me lha mdun du bka' nyan tshul// kha gdangs lto bar dang po'i nyin// pra ma ra tsa gzhan gsum yang*// lhag pa'i nyi ma rer shes bya// dad nas gtso bo yab yum dang*// phyis nas bka' sdod de la'o// spyan drangs gzu dpang bstod bskul mthar// aṃ a kro ta ga ya man ta ka hūṃ/ pe ta li rak+ṣa e ka dza ti bh+yo bh+yo/ hūṃ ya ma ra tsa sa to me ya hūṃ ya me to ru na yo ta ya/ hūṃ ya to yo ni/ ra yak+ṣe ya hūṃ/ yak+ṣe yats+tsha nir ma ya/ hūṃ ya ma rak+ṣa phu ra ya/

badz+ra ka ta tsan+dha ya ma me tsa ti li tra te hūṃ/ oṃ a g+ne de ba ra tsa ye/ che ge mo da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ ā ka r+sha ya badz+ra dza la la raṃ/ bas mi ku ru mā ra ya/ kha raṃ dza la raṃ/ drag po'i sngags 'dis sreg rdzas phul/ gnod byed zhal du (4na7)gsol bar bsam// nyi ma bzhi yi bar du bya// brgya byin nyid kyang brlag 'gyur na// gzhan ma kun la smos ci dgos// g.yang gzhi'i steng du dkyil 'khor bya// dbus su zhal gtor chen po bzhag /mtha' mar zor rdzas bskor ba'i nas// phur kha gzhan gyi ming byad gzhug /dug chu yungs kar khrag gi snying*// rdo 'phang dug rdog mi kha'i rdzas// dug sbal spangs rtsang yungs mtshe zor// bdun nam nyer gcig brgya rtsa ste// mtha' 'bring rab tu shes pas bshams// nyin phyed dus nas brtsams nas su// nam phyed dus su 'phang bar bya// sngags pa dgra phyogs kha bltas la// sha ri bh+yo ma ri bh+yo/ khrag ma ma bh+yo/ rtser snying bh+yo/ snying bh+yo/ mak+ṣi thod khrag dza/ khrag ti snying ya ya/ nri tri chod/ nā ga chod// mu lo chod/ sha lo chod/ sha la kyid kyid bh+yo bh+yo/ a ti pra ma ni mā ra ya zlog /pa ro bi dan tsin+dha tsin+dha bh+yo/ ti pur shag bh+yo/ ti pur tsan+d+ra tsa kra bh+yo/ ti pur me shuṃ tsur ni bh+yo/ ti pur mā ra ya ni bh+yo/ ma ma trag rak+ṣa mu dra snying kha rag thun bh+yo/ bzlog bzlog ni sha ku ru thun bh+yo bzlog bzlog /mi tshig ma 'dres bzla bar bya// brgya phrag re nas rdzas la btab// las kyi pho nya de la bstim// nad dang mtshon char gyur par bsgom// lha bskul dpung bskyed dpang btsugs nas// pra ti ma 'ur rdo sbrul du bsam// g.yas su bskor zhing dgra la 'phang*// las gshin dmag tshogs de dag gis// dgra bo 'khor bcas srog bcad cing*// yul khang nor rdzas brlag byas bsam// 'di ni ngan pa dgu thub ste// las 'grub nas ni gtang rag 'bul// las kyi gshin rje'i sbyor ba'i dug

/nag po ha la ha la zhes// chos skyong de yis skabs phye ba'i// sngags 'chang pad+ma dkar pos sbyar// dge bas bstan pa rgyas par shog// /chos sbyin rgya cher spel ba'i ched// par bzhengs glegs bu re re la// dngul krang yon 'gyed mdzad po ni// chos rgyal bsod nams rgyal mtshan no// maṅga laṃ/// /
